mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 7.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over three months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 850.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential sales (RSAFS) combined with very low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a weak housing market amid accommodative policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic weakness spreads.
regime_hint: weak housing market in loose monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and RSAFS declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction phase that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
